edits.new:
Then the move is refused, nothing changes and the message is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S7-E6013-APP-AC11)

  Scenario: AC13 Each business rule of section 8 is covered by a criterion and a test case (BR1 to BR10)
    Given the coverage table of section 8 lists the rules BR1 to BR10
    When the story is checked against sections 7 and 16
    Then every BR ID maps to a criterion of section 7 and a test case of section 16

  Scenario: AC14 An unauthenticated, forbidden or unknown request is answered 401, 403 or 404 (provided operations)
    Given a request without valid credentials, a role without the Write-off and posting right C, and a request for an unknown case ID
    When the operation is called with each request
    Then the answers are 401, 403 and 404 respectively, nothing changes and no record is written

  Scenario: AC15 A replay of a write with the same Idempotency-Key answers the first result (X7, BR8)
    Given a write has been accepted under an Idempotency-Key
    When the same write is replayed with that Idempotency-Key
    Then the answer is the first answer, no second row set or decision record is written and the repeat is counted

  Scenario: AC16 A retried or timed-out activity writes nothing twice (X5, BR7)
    Given a consumed contract does not answer inside 2 s
    When the activity retries on the workflow's own schedule
    Then nothing is written and no move is answered on the failed attempt, and each row set and record is written once
